name: RELICS
full_name: REactor neutrino LIquid xenon Coherent elastic Scattering experiment
summary: RELICS develops a compact dual-phase xenon time projection chamber for coherent reactor-antineutrino scattering at Sanmen. Prototype studies establish charge response, purification and operational performance before a full reactor-neutrino measurement.
detection_principle: Ionization electrons from low-energy recoils are drifted and extracted into xenon gas to produce electroluminescence. The programme emphasizes few-electron sensitivity and control of impurities and delayed-electron backgrounds.
